interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Jsem žárliv na tvého pána PRA-…?; ?ARLIV requires g → Z; following designation unresolved.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [I am jealous of your gentleman PRA-…?; ?ARLIV requires g → Z; designation unresolved.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Byla mi divná návštěva pána…; only this fragment.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [The gentleman’s visit seemed strange to me…; only this fragment.]

interpretive_fragments.literal_fragment: MNE MOCI BOLELA HLAVA. DNES JE
interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Mne mocí bolela hlava. Dnes je…; literal MOCI retained, no silent moc repair.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [My head hurt … Today it is…; literal MOCI is awkward and not silently repaired to moc (“a lot”).]

interpretive_fragments.literal_fragment: I V NEDELI MNOHO, CO DELA ASI MOJE
interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [I v neděli mnoho, co dělá asi moje…; a fragment, no cross-row bridge.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [Also on Sunday a lot, what my … might be doing; fragment only.]

interpretive_fragments.literal_fragment: STYS?A SE MI PO TOBE MOC!
interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Stýská se mi po tobě moc!; STYS?A requires q → K.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [I miss you very much!; STYS?A requires q → K.]

interpretation_scope: Only listed literal-bound fragments have Czech/English proposals. Other text remains literal and unresolved; no complete fluent translation, order between opposite/margin blocks, identity or chronology is asserted.
